    - gps_time:
        comment: 1st column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: Continuous seconds past 01-Jan-2000 11:59:47 UTC
        units: second
    - GRACEFO_id:
        comment: 2nd column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: GRACE-FO satellite identifier
        units: char
        valid_range: C,D
        value_meanings:
          - C = GRACE-FO 1 (GRACE C)
          - D = GRACE-FO 2 (GRACE D)
    - sca_id:
        comment: 3rd column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: SCA identification number
        valid_range: 1, 23
        value_meanings:
          - 1 = SCA 1
          - 2 = SCA 2
          - 3 = SCAs 1 and 2
          - 4 = SCA 3
          - 5 = SCAs 1 and 3
          - 6 = SCAs 2 and 3
          - 7 = SCAs 1, 2 and 3
          - 16 = IMU
          - 17 = SCA 1 and IMU
          - 18 = SCA 2 and IMU
          - 19 = SCAs 1 and 2 and IMU
          - 20 = SCA 3 and IMU
          - 21 = SCAs 1 and 3 and IMU
          - 22 = SCAs 2 and 3 and IMU
          - 23 = SCAs 1, 2, and 3 and IMU
    - quatangle:
        comment: 4th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: Cos(theta/2) component of rotation quaternion
    - quaticoeff:
        comment: 5th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: i-component of rotation quaternion
    - quatjcoeff:
        comment: 6th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: j-component of rotation quaternion
    - quatkcoeff:
        comment: 7th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: k-component of rotation quaternion
    - qual_rss:
        comment: 8th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: RSS of formal error of quaternions
    - qualflg:
        comment: 9th column
        coverage_content_type: qualityInformation
        flag_masks: 1b, 2b, 4b, 8b, 16b, 32b, 64b, 128b
        flag_meanings:
          - bit 0 = Interpolated value
          - bit 1 = Interpolated value using relative attitude data (IMU)
          - bit 2 = Not defined
          - bit 3 = Data from 1 star camera only
          - bits 4-7 = Not defined
        long_name: Quality flags, bit 0 is rightmost
